events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Sir Michael Philip Jagger, lead singer of The Rolling Stones, was born on July 26, 1943.

angles.name: Enduring rock icon
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young today! Mick Jagger, the legendary frontman of The Rolling Stones, continues to defy expectations. What's your favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being the very first music video ever aired.

angles.name: MTV's ironic start
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV launched with a song that ironically predicted its own impact: 'Video Killed The Radio Star'. Did it, though?

events.title: Oasis release Definitely Maybe
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Britpop debut anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering the album that kicked off a phenomenon! Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' dropped 32 years ago this month. What's your top track from the debut?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15 to 18, 1969, attracting nearly half a million people for '3 Days of Peace & Music'.

angles.name: Peace & Music at Woodstock
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the summer of love culminated in Woodstock. Three days of peace, music, and a generation-defining moment. Wish you were there?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who we lost on this day in 1977. His legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles release Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic album cover
angles.copy: The album with THAT iconic zebra crossing cover – The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' was released 57 years ago this month. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Christine Ellen 'Chrissie' Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Pretenders' frontwoman birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' frontwoman, still rocking after all these years. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher, best known as the lead singer of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' roll star's birthday
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon released Imagine
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic anthem 'Imagine' as a single in the US on October 11, 1971, and in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's enduring message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' first captivated the world. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful today as it ever was.

events.title: Apple released the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: The iPod changed everything
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped 25 years ago this month? It put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed how we listened to music forever. What was on your first iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', which premiered on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Who's your favourite Bond?
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 007 first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Winston Ono Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate globally. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy legend's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy icon. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles release 'The White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album anniversary
angles.copy: An iconic double album that broke new ground! The Beatles' 'White Album' was released 58 years ago this month. Which track is your hidden gem?
